metadata.title: The a0 Galaxy Law and its Screened Khronon Action: Field Equations, Lean Certificates, and the Closure Record (Working Note)
metadata.description:
Working note, version 1.4 (2026-11-07; same day as v1.0 to v1.3). AI-assisted research programme; not peer reviewed; not reproduced by any outside group. kappa = 1/2 is fitted; the theory is not closed; nothing here says the data favour this framework over any other.

Gravity carries one extra scale, a0 = kappa c sqrt(G rho_DE), kappa = 1/2 fitted (proved not derivable from the framework's premises), realised by the v3s screened khronon action, with AC2q as the candidate successor. This note states the action in Legendre form, derives the covariant field equations of both actions and certifies the algebra (sympy Euler-Lagrange residuals, Lean 4 theorems with mutation twins, finite-difference solvers on known solutions), and gives every gate the programme set itself its frozen verdict in one table. PASS: Cassini, PPN, tensor speed, galaxy lensing = dynamics, SPARC on the action's exact field, PN sign, well-posedness of the Pi^6-blended switch in 1D, 2D and 3D. FAIL: AGC 114905, Malin 1, the canonical FG1 tilt, light-cone causality on anisotropic backgrounds (physical, unobservable). After the joint systematic budget explains the X-ray ellipticals, the KiDS colour split and the bright M31 dwarfs, the residue is X-COP clusters, groups and Coma UDGs, whose needed extra mass varies about a hundredfold between classes, and separately the CMB-lensing shape, which needs cold extra gravity at z 3400. Four walls close every sector class tried: cold fluid, fixed-temperature sea, hot collisionless fermion, shock-sourced entropy sector; primordial black holes give no shared window; every switch key between discs and hot systems is dead. Three frozen kill tests remain: Gaia DR4 wide binaries (the action predicts Newton), a0(z) flat to z 2.33, and lensing = dynamics. The supplement archive carries every Lean source and build output, the closure tables, the frozen criteria and the prediction file at the cited commits. Companion to PAPER67 (10.5281/zenodo.23968171), PAPER68 (10.5281/zenodo.23990944) and PAPER69 (10.5281/zenodo.24025170).

Version 1.1 adds: an erratum to v1.0 for the CMB-lensing Limber kernel used since lane QX3 (it omitted the lensing potential's k^-4; confirmed by an independent rebuild), with 20 affected labels re-stated pending the owner's decision; the final moving-Sun label (PASS, scoped); two framework candidates assembled from the record and graded the same day, both FAIL on their frozen lines (a kicked collisionless carrier: the law's own escape speeds keep it in massive spirals; a cold component born clumped at the nodes: the primary CMB tolerates a bias of 0.997-1.001 and the Lyman-alpha forest tolerates under 0.3 % clumped); the fact that bound hosts inside r500 hold about 1 % of the cold component the CMB requires; and a closing statement of what one relation and one action unify and what they do not. kappa = 1/2 remains fitted; the theory is not closed.

Version 1.2 adds: an independent rebuild of the primary-CMB requirement for a cold component (confirmed: baryons-only fails by Delta chi^2 above 1.6e5 on both footings; omega_d/omega_b 5.41); the result that the action's own clock-depth dust cannot form the 50-100 kpc cored profile the clusters show; the dynamical test of an outside solver's release-speed identity on the certified fold machinery (no verdict by its control; every graded row in the local-stiffness regime, speeds tracking the well); and the re-read of the remaining CMB cells on the corrected kernel. Every test lane opened on 2026-11-07 has landed. The deposited action is the full action the record can write; its one unresolved failure is a contradiction between three independently confirmed measurements and the action's own cold term. kappa = 1/2 remains fitted; the theory is not closed.

Version 1.3 adds: the owner's acceptance of the corrected-kernel labels as standing (decision file in the supplement): the erratum rows that read 'pending owner' now read 're-stated (owner 2026-11-07)', with old and corrected values side by side and the frozen result files untouched; none of the accepted moves opens a door, every FAIL and NO-GO stands, and no row in the record is pending. kappa = 1/2 remains fitted; the theory is not closed.

Version 1.4 adds to the supplement archive the one-page statement of the theory as the record stands (FINAL_THEORY_2026_11_07.md): the relation, the action written out, what it is a complete theory of, where it stops, the theorem of exhaustion and the statement. The paper itself is unchanged from v1.3.

Version 1.5 adds the anatomy of the CMB requirement (lanes CMB1 and CMB2, both footings): about four-fifths of the baryons-only misfit is a smooth matter-like expansion (omega_X 0.108 recovers 79 %); the remaining fifth is the third-to-second and odd-to-even peak heights and the first-peak position, which demand still potential wells through recombination; no degree of freedom in the certified action other than clustering dust supplies them. The inference holds on the framework background; what the record breaks is the identification of that component with the agent that flattens galaxies. Also VR1 (no length in the action fixes kappa = 1/2, kappa stays fitted) and SA1 (settling-age dependence has no term in the action). CMB3 (assumption audit) is listed as running; its reading goes into v1.6. Adopts nothing. kappa = 1/2 remains fitted; the theory is not closed.

Version 1.6 adds the assumption audit of the CMB cold-component inference (lane CMB3): the inference holds on the framework background under every assumption tested, the law inert at recombination (its response follows the acoustic wave; the large-a0 corner is closed by X35), lensing with a free amplitude (the cold fit picks exactly 1.00), N_eff and helium, tilt and running, and widened nuisances (nuisance-sensitive at -25 %); the only assumption the record breaks is the identification of the recombination component with the rotation-curve mass, on both footings; the smallest baryons-only misfit under any single relaxation is +122,711. It also adds the quarantined hybrid test lane HY1 (owner's rule lift for that lane only): the a0 law with kappa free plus a universal cold component at the CMB's fraction, placed by the record's own dust dynamics, wrecks every disc rotation curve and over-fills every cluster core at every kappa, so the component cannot be put back into galaxies. Debt named, not computed: the cold fit sets the law's boost to one while its own recombination gradients sit a few times above a0. Adopts nothing. kappa = 1/2 remains fitted; the theory is not closed.

Version 1.7 adds the two owner-named lanes on the action's own K(Q) dust sector, both FAIL on both footings. KR1: a running mass scale from the authors' own non-quadratic (DBI) K runs the right way and passes nucleosynthesis (no stiff phase), the primary CMB, corrected-kernel lensing, growth, the forest and the speed of gravitational waves, yet for any convex K the mass is set by the sector's own local density, so galaxy turnaround dust (the background density of z 4.3) carries a Jeans length of 2.8 kpc against a turnaround radius of 234 kpc and is captured, wrecking the rotation curves. KR2: at the CMB's amount, no present-day mass scale between 0.1 and 79 Mpc^-1 passes; X-COP is over-filled by about one dex or left hollow, groups and host capacity are disjoint, and with the local-density mass no window survives. The K(Q) sector is therefore exhausted at the level of its functional form, from the early universe and from the present day. Adopts nothing. kappa = 1/2 remains fitted; the theory is not closed.

Version 1.8 adds one quarantined test lane, BG1, launched on the owner's word after the orchestrator reported that every local gravitational variable (acceleration, potential depth, density, temperature, size) is non-monotone across the three regimes the data set: the z 3 forest web needs the clustering component at low values of all of them, galaxy halos forbid it one step up, and cluster cores need it again. BG1 tried the one key that separates the regimes by the state of the baryons instead: the dust phase of the K(Q) sector converts to the smooth phase at a rate proportional to the local cold-baryon density (T below 1e4 K), with one declared coefficient. FAIL on both footings. The galaxy side works at a coefficient near 1e3 per solar mass per cubic parsec per Gyr (SPARC, gas-rich low-density discs, KiDS isolated lenses, ellipticals under the IMF reading, both dwarf-spheroidal samples at the line; discs retain 0.4 percent), but the densest cold baryons in cosmic history are the neutral gas of the dark ages, whose exposure is one seventh of a disc's, so the same rate converts 97 percent of the component before z 20 and the dark-ages, forest and growth gates allow at most 6; the windows are disjoint by a factor 400 and the ratio is scale-free. Independently of the coefficient, Coma ultra-diffuse galaxies (under-filled 0.65 to 0.92 dex), groups (at most 7 of 20) and X-COP (over-filled 0.06 to 0.10 dex at the CMB amount) fail at every value. One mutation did not bite as frozen and the label does not rest on it. Adopts nothing. kappa = 1/2 remains fitted; the theory is not closed.
